concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  r47:
    name: R44 original .ko + Module.symvers / immutable proof / NO FLASH
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'Chrizz100/veux-nongki-universal-kernel' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 29
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      R47_ROOT: /tmp/veux-r47
    steps:
    - name: Checkout exact project repository read-only
      uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Authenticate existing R31 package and create self-contained R47 auditor
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        printf '%s  %s\n' \
          '8c37937e745fa9b335bd2a3a3719c73387891d5ec830f695455ca2659ff88de7' \
          'VEUX_R31_WALT_RMNET_BINARY_PAIR_MAIN.zip' | sha256sum -c -
        mkdir -p "$R47_ROOT/src" "$R47_ROOT/tests" "$R47_ROOT/inputs" "$R47_ROOT/fixtures" "$R47_ROOT/out"
        cat > "$R47_ROOT/src/r47_gate.py" <<'R47_PYTHON_GATE'
        #!/usr/bin/env python3
        """VEUX R47: only reads pinned R44 ELF modules / Module.symvers and emits text evidence.
        Never imports private device report, mutates kernel sources, installs modules, or flashes.
        """
        import argparse
        import csv
        import hashlib
        import io
        import json
        import pathlib
        import re
        import stat
        import struct
        import sys
        import zipfile

        R44_REPO_SHA = '1e4938c8c9ce33fff743b405ae85de17a204150b'
        R44_SYMVERS_SHA = '5131e75259d76acd00e08143d76d22d04d1ec86b18b0d70b84fa05b7e1e4049d'
        R44_ZIP_SHA = '47d414172d0227bbbfda85671a21dcce35872f2c35d0ffb371cd5f6f1dfdcf6e'
        R44_DIAG_ZIP_SHA = '8d117d66953ca7cb24546b89680e0ff368ea99e5cb4f2eada7f9c2bdc9ad672f'
        R44_PROOF_ZIP_SHA = '82108d1caed1ecc861c38dd96b5a16a151f74d2c5728140624a1007e6401a6a3'
        R31_ZIP_SHA = '8c37937e745fa9b335bd2a3a3719c73387891d5ec830f695455ca2659ff88de7'
        R44_MODULES = {
            'rmnet_shs': {
                'path': 'techpack/datarmnet-ext/shs/rmnet_shs.ko',
                'r31_path': 'modules/r20/rmnet_shs.ko',
                'bytes': 3901544, 'sha256': '3d69e8d5cd33675c3b8e4174c8c8260199eac91ade6f47e45bf966e3c698e516',
                'expected_imports': 108,
            },
            'rmnet_offload': {
                'path': 'techpack/datarmnet-ext/offload/rmnet_offload.ko',
                'r31_path': 'modules/r20/rmnet_offload.ko',
                'bytes': 2080832, 'sha256': '0c290be4656ffed3dd0763650d270d79353ab830f73740748b03e21c83ad05cb',
                'expected_imports': 32,
            },
        }
        EXPECTED_VERMAGIC = '5.4.274~positron SMP preempt mod_unload modversions aarch64'
        EXPECTED_CRC_LAYOUT = 0x0bcef28c
        HEX64 = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}\Z')


        def ensure(cond, why):
            if not cond:
                raise ValueError(why)


        def sha(data):
            return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


        def hash_file(path):
            h = hashlib.sha256()
            with pathlib.Path(path).open('rb') as f:
                for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
                    h.update(chunk)
            return h.hexdigest()


        def pinned_file(path, expected, max_size):
            p = pathlib.Path(path)
            ensure(p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), 'PINNED_FILE_MISSING_OR_SYMLINK:' + p.name)
            ensure(0 < p.stat().st_size <= max_size, 'PINNED_FILE_SIZE:' + p.name)
            ensure(hash_file(p) == expected, 'PINNED_FILE_SHA256:' + p.name)
            return p


        def zip_validate(z, max_count=400, max_total=2_000_000_000):
            ms = z.infolist()
            ensure(0 < len(ms) <= max_count, 'ZIP_MEMBER_COUNT')
            names = [m.filename for m in ms]
            ensure(len(names) == len(set(names)), 'ZIP_DUPLICATE_MEMBER')
            total = 0
            for m in ms:
                n = m.filename
                pp = pathlib.PurePosixPath(n)
                ensure(n and not n.startswith('/') and '\\' not in n and '..' not in pp.parts and not pp.is_absolute(), 'ZIP_UNSAFE_PATH')
                ensure(not stat.S_ISLNK(m.external_attr >> 16), 'ZIP_SYMLINK')
                ensure(m.file_size >= 0 and m.file_size <= 800_000_000, 'ZIP_OVERSIZED_MEMBER')
                total += m.file_size
            ensure(total <= max_total, 'ZIP_EXCESSIVE_TOTAL')
            return ms


        def require_exact(z, name, max_uncompressed):
            infos = [i for i in z.infolist() if i.filename == name]
            ensure(len(infos) == 1, 'ZIP_EXACT_MEMBER_MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS:' + name)
            ensure(infos[0].file_size <= max_uncompressed, 'ZIP_MEMBER_TOO_BIG:' + name)
            return z.read(infos[0])


        def require_unique_suffix(z, suffix, max_uncompressed):
            infos = [i for i in z.infolist() if i.filename == suffix or i.filename.endswith('/' + suffix)]
            ensure(len(infos) == 1, 'ZIP_SUFFIX_MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS:' + suffix)
            ensure(infos[0].file_size <= max_uncompressed, 'ZIP_MEMBER_TOO_BIG:' + suffix)
            return infos[0].filename, z.read(infos[0])


        def parse_symvers(data):
            ensure(data and len(data) < 2_000_000, 'SYMVERS_SIZE')
            seen = {}
            for ix, raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(), 1):
                f = raw.decode('utf-8', 'strict').split('\t')
                ensure(len(f) >= 4 and re.fullmatch(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{8}', f[0]) is not None,
                       'SYMVERS_ROW_INVALID:' + str(ix))
                name = f[1]
                ensure(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]+', name) is not None, 'SYMVERS_SYMBOL_INVALID')
                ensure(name not in seen, 'SYMVERS_DUPLICATE_SYMBOL:' + name)
                seen[name] = {'crc': int(f[0], 16), 'provider': f[2], 'export': f[3]}
            ensure(len(seen) > 10000, 'SYMVERS_TOO_FEW')
            return seen


        def _elf_sections(data):
            ensure(isinstance(data, bytes) and len(data) >= 64 and data[:4] == b'\x7fELF', 'ELF_MAGIC')
            ensure(data[4:6] == b'\x02\x01', 'ELF_REQUIRES_ELF64_LITTLE_ENDIAN')
            ensure(struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 16)[0] == 1, 'ELF_NOT_RELOCATABLE')
            ensure(struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 18)[0] == 183, 'ELF_NOT_AARCH64')
            e_shoff = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, 40)[0]
            e_shentsize, e_shnum, e_shstrndx = struct.unpack_from('<HHH', data, 58)
            ensure(e_shentsize == 64 and 3 < e_shnum <= 256 and e_shstrndx < e_shnum,
                   'ELF_SECTION_TABLE_INVALID')
            ensure(e_shoff > 0 and e_shoff + e_shentsize * e_shnum <= len(data), 'ELF_SECTION_TABLE_BOUNDS')
            raw = []
            for i in range(e_shnum):
                h = struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ', data, e_shoff + i * e_shentsize)
                ensure(h[4] + h[5] <= len(data) or h[1] == 8, 'ELF_SECTION_BOUNDS')
                raw.append(h)
            h = raw[e_shstrndx]
            names = data[h[4]:h[4]+h[5]]
            sections = {}
            for h in raw:
                start = h[0]
                ensure(start < len(names), 'ELF_SECTION_NAME_BOUNDS')
                end = names.find(b'\0', start)
                ensure(end >= 0, 'ELF_SECTION_UNTERMINATED')
                name = names[start:end].decode('ascii', 'strict')
                ensure(name not in sections or not name, 'ELF_SECTION_NAME_DUPLICATE')
                sections[name] = (h, b'' if h[1] == 8 else data[h[4]:h[4]+h[5]])
            for needed in ('__versions', '.modinfo', '.note.gnu.build-id', '.symtab', '.strtab'):
                ensure(needed in sections, 'ELF_SECTION_MISSING:' + needed)
            return sections


        def parse_elf_module(data, expected_name):
            sections = _elf_sections(data)
            vm = sections['__versions'][1]
            ensure(vm and len(vm) % 64 == 0 and len(vm) < 50_000, 'ELF_VERSIONS_ALIGNMENT')
            versions = {}
            for p in range(0, len(vm), 64):
                crc = struct.unpack_from('<Q', vm, p)[0]
                rawname = vm[p+8:p+64]
                ensure(b'\0' in rawname, 'ELF_VERSION_NAME_NOT_TERMINATED')
                name = rawname.split(b'\0', 1)[0].decode('ascii', 'strict')
                ensure(re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_]+', name) is not None, 'ELF_VERSION_NAME_INVALID')
                ensure(name not in versions, 'ELF_VERSION_DUPLICATE')
                versions[name] = crc
            info = sections['.modinfo'][1].split(b'\0')
            params = {}
            for t in info:
                if not t or b'=' not in t: continue
                k,v=t.split(b'=',1)
                key=k.decode('ascii','strict')
                if key in ('name','vermagic','depends','intree'):
                    ensure(key not in params, 'ELF_MODINFO_DUPLICATE:' + key)
                    params[key] = v.decode('utf-8','strict')
            ensure(params.get('name') == expected_name, 'ELF_MODULE_NAME_DIFFERENT')
            ensure(params.get('vermagic') == EXPECTED_VERMAGIC, 'ELF_VERMAGIC_DIFFERENT')
            ensure(params.get('depends', '') == '', 'ELF_UNEXPECTED_KO_DEPENDENCIES')
            ensure(params.get('intree', '') == 'Y', 'ELF_NOT_INTREE')
            note = sections['.note.gnu.build-id'][1]
            ensure(len(note) >= 16, 'ELF_BUILDID_NOTE_TOO_SMALL')
            nsz, dsz, typ = struct.unpack_from('<III', note, 0)
            n_padded = (nsz + 3) & ~3
            d_padded = (dsz + 3) & ~3
            ensure(typ == 3 and nsz == 4 and 0 < dsz <= 32, 'ELF_BUILDID_NOTE_HEADER')
            ensure(12 + n_padded + d_padded <= len(note) and note[12:16] == b'GNU\0', 'ELF_BUILDID_NOTE_BOUNDS')
            build_id = note[12 + n_padded: 12 + n_padded + dsz].hex()
            # Parse the actual ELF symtab rather than equating __versions with all undefined symbols.
            symhead = sections['.symtab'][0]
            symdata = sections['.symtab'][1]
            strings = sections['.strtab'][1]
            ensure(symhead[9] == 24 and len(symdata) % 24 == 0, 'ELF_SYMTAB_INVALID')
            undef = set()
            for j in range(0, len(symdata), 24):
                st_name, _st_info, _st_other, st_shndx, _st_value, _st_size = struct.unpack_from('<IBBHQQ', symdata, j)
                if st_shndx != 0 or st_name == 0: continue
                ensure(st_name < len(strings), 'ELF_UNDEFINED_NAME_BOUNDS')
                end = strings.find(b'\0', st_name)
                ensure(end >= 0, 'ELF_UNDEFINED_NAME_UNTERMINATED')
                sym = strings[st_name:end].decode('ascii','strict')
                ensure(re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_]+', sym) is not None, 'ELF_UNDEFINED_NAME_INVALID')
                undef.add(sym)
            ensure(undef == set(versions) - {'module_layout'}, 'ELF_VERSIONS_UNDEFINED_MISMATCH')
            return {'build_id': build_id, 'modinfo': params, 'versions': versions, 'undefined_count': len(undef)}


        def compare_module(name, module_bytes, symvers, known_sha):
            spec = R44_MODULES[name]
            ensure(len(module_bytes) == spec['bytes'] and sha(module_bytes) == spec['sha256'], 'R44_MODULE_BYTES_OR_HASH_DIFFERENT:' + name)
            ensure(known_sha == spec['sha256'], 'R44_BUILD_REPORT_HASH_DIFFERENT:' + name)
            module = parse_elf_module(module_bytes, name)
            vv = module['versions']
            ensure(len(vv) == spec['expected_imports'], 'R44_IMPORT_COUNT_DIFFERENT:' + name)
            ensure(vv.get('module_layout') == EXPECTED_CRC_LAYOUT, 'R44_MODULE_LAYOUT_DIFFERENT')
            rows = []
            for symbol, actual in sorted(vv.items()):
                expected = symvers.get(symbol)
                ensure(expected is not None, 'R44_MISSING_EXPORT:' + symbol)
                ensure(actual == expected['crc'], 'R44_MODULE_CRC_MISMATCH:' + symbol)
                rows.append({'module': name, 'symbol': symbol, 'module_crc': '0x%08x' % actual,
                             'kernel_crc': '0x%08x' % expected['crc'], 'provider': expected['provider'],
                             'result': 'MATCH'})
            summary = {'name':name, 'sha256':sha(module_bytes), 'bytes':len(module_bytes),
                       'build_id':module['build_id'], 'vermagic':module['modinfo']['vermagic'],
                       'depends':module['modinfo'].get('depends',''), 'symbol_imports':len(rows),
                       'matched_imports':len(rows), 'missing_exports':0, 'crc_mismatches':0,
                       'undefined_elf_symbols':module['undefined_count']}
            return summary, rows


        def audit_inputs(r31, r44linked, r44diags, r44proof, run):
            ensure(run.get('id') == 40168917960 and run.get('status') == 'completed' and
                   run.get('conclusion') == 'success' and run.get('head_sha') == R44_REPO_SHA and
                   run.get('head_branch') == 'main', 'R44_SOURCE_RUN_NOT_PROVEN')
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r44diags)) as z:
                zip_validate(z)
                build = json.loads(require_exact(z,'R20_BUILD_RESULT.json',40_000).decode())
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r44proof)) as z:
                zip_validate(z)
                proof = json.loads(require_exact(z,'R44_FULL_BUILD_RESULT.json',20_000).decode())
            ensure(build.get('status') == 'R20_WALT_ON_VMLINUX_IMAGE_DTB_AND_MODULE_BUILD_PROVEN_NO_FLASH' and
                   build.get('module_symvers_sha256') == R44_SYMVERS_SHA and
                   build.get('modules_built') is True and build.get('vmlinux_linked') is True, 'R44_BUILD_REPORT_INVALID')
            ensure(proof.get('status') == 'R44_PATCHED_FULL_ARM64_BUILD_SUCCESS_NO_FLASH' and
                   proof.get('r20_full_image_proven') is True and
                   proof.get('module_count') == 6 and
                   proof.get('vendor_abi_proven') is False and proof.get('flash_allowed') is False,
                   'R44_SOURCE_PATCH_PROOF_INVALID')
            build_files = {v['path']:v for v in build['module_files']}
            ensure(len(build_files) == len(build['module_files']) == 6, 'R44_BUILD_MODULE_SET_INVALID')
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r31)) as z:
                zip_validate(z)
                r31_modules = {name: require_exact(z, spec['r31_path'], spec['bytes'])
                               for name,spec in R44_MODULES.items()}
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r44linked)) as z:
                zip_validate(z)
                symname, symdata = require_unique_suffix(z,'Module.symvers',1_000_000)
                ensure(sha(symdata) == R44_SYMVERS_SHA, 'R44_ORIGINAL_SYMVERS_SHA_INVALID')
                exports = parse_symvers(symdata)
                ensure(exports['module_layout']['crc'] == EXPECTED_CRC_LAYOUT, 'R44_LAYOUT_EXPORT_NOT_PINNED')
                results=[]; rows=[]; origins=[]
                for name,spec in R44_MODULES.items():
                    member, actual = require_unique_suffix(z, spec['path'], 6_000_000)
                    rec = build_files.get(spec['path'])
                    ensure(rec is not None and rec.get('sha256') == spec['sha256'] and rec.get('bytes') == spec['bytes'],
                           'R44_OFFICIAL_BUILD_MODULE_RECORD_MISMATCH:'+name)
                    ensure(actual == r31_modules[name], 'R31_VS_R44_BYTE_IDENTITY_NOT_PROVEN:'+name)
                    summary, imports = compare_module(name, actual, exports, rec['sha256'])
                    results.append(summary); rows += imports; origins.append({'module':name,'artifact_member':member,
                        'baseline_member':spec['r31_path'],'byteidentical':True})
            ensure(sum(s['symbol_imports'] for s in results) == 140, 'R44_140_IMPORTS_NOT_PROVEN')
            return {'schema':'VEUX_R47_R44_RMNET_BINARY_ELF_PROVENANCE_V1',
                    'result':'R44_RMNET_140_OF_140_CRC_MATCH_AND_BYTE_IDENTITY',
                    'r44_source_run':40168917960,'r44_source_sha':R44_REPO_SHA,
                    'r44_module_symvers_sha256':R44_SYMVERS_SHA,
                    'modules':results,'artifact_origins':origins,'r44_symvers_member':symname,
                    'module_pair_byteidentical_to_r31':True,
                    'historical_2ef0_modules_suitable_for_r44':False,
                    'runtime_module_load_tested':False,
                    'device_loader_path_proven':False,
                    'vendor_rom_init_compatibility_proven':False,
                    'complete_vendor_abi_proven':False,
                    'bootloader_dtbo_selection_proven':False,
                    'boot_ready':False,'flash_allowed':False,'source_modified':False,
                    'kernel_built':False}, rows


        def main():
            ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
            for opt in ('r31','r44-linked','r44-diags','r44-proof','r44-run','out'):
                ap.add_argument('--'+opt,required=True)
            args=ap.parse_args()
            out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
            out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            r31 = pinned_file(args.r31, R31_ZIP_SHA, 10_000_000).read_bytes()
            linked = pinned_file(args.r44_linked, R44_ZIP_SHA, 300_000_000).read_bytes()
            diags = pinned_file(args.r44_diags, R44_DIAG_ZIP_SHA, 100_000).read_bytes()
            proof = pinned_file(args.r44_proof, R44_PROOF_ZIP_SHA, 100_000).read_bytes()
            run = json.loads(pathlib.Path(args.r44_run).read_text())
            result, imports = audit_inputs(r31,linked,diags,proof,run)
            (out/'R47_RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
            (out/'R47_MODULE_ELF.json').write_text(json.dumps(result['modules'],indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
            with (out/'R47_RMNET_140_IMPORTS.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
                wr=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=['module','symbol','module_crc','kernel_crc','provider','result'])
                wr.writeheader();wr.writerows(imports)
            lines=[
              'VEUX R47 – R44 echte RMNET-Binaerdateien und CRCs geprueft',
              'Quelle: unveraendertes GitHub-R44-Original-Artefakt (SHA-256 gepinnt) + R31-Binaerbeleg.',
              'R44 Module.symvers ebenfalls mit der originalen SHA-256-Pruefsumme gepinnt.',
              'rmnet_shs 108/108 Kernel-Importe, rmnet_offload 32/32; kein CRC-Konflikt, kein fehlender Export.',
              'Beide R44 .ko byteidentisch zum bereits geprueften R31-Paar.',
              'ELF=AArch64 ET_REL, intree=Y, vermagic=5.4.274~positron, keine .ko depends.',
              'WICHTIG: Weder auf dem R44-Kernel geladen noch durch ROM-Init oder BakaSU getestet.',
              'R46 privater Geraetebericht wurde NICHT in GitHub hochgeladen.',
              'Alte 2EF0 .ko duerfen wegen R45 CRC-Abweichungen nicht in R44 uebernommen werden.',
              'Weitere Boot-Gates: Loader-Interaktion, Vendor-ABI, DTBO-Bootloader, SELinux/VINTF, Root-Integration, Backup/Recovery.',
              'BOOT_READY=NO; VENDOR_ABI_UNPROVEN; FLASH_ALLOWED=NO; KEINE FLASHDATEIEN.'
            ]
            (out/'R47_BERICHT_DE.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
            print('R47_R44_BINARY_IMPORTS_140_OF_140=PASS; R44_R31_BITIDENTITY=PASS; BOOT_READY=NO; FLASH_ALLOWED=NO')


        if __name__ == '__main__':
            try: main()
            except Exception as e:
                print('R47_FAIL_CLOSED:'+str(e),file=sys.stderr)
                raise SystemExit(2)
        R47_PYTHON_GATE
        cat > "$R47_ROOT/tests/test_r47_gate.py" <<'R47_PYTHON_TESTS'
        """R47 adversarial tests with genuine locally supplied R44 ELF binaries / symvers."""
        import copy
        import io
        import json
        import os
        import pathlib
        import stat
        import struct
        import unittest
        import zipfile

        import r47_gate as g


        class R47EvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
            @classmethod
            def setUpClass(cls):
                here = pathlib.Path(os.environ['R47_FIXTURES'])
                cls.modules = {name:(here/(name+'.ko')).read_bytes() for name in g.R44_MODULES}
                cls.symdata = (here/'R44_Module.symvers').read_bytes()
                cls.sym = g.parse_symvers(cls.symdata)
                cls.diag = (here/'VEUX_R44_R2_FULL_BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS_40168917960.zip').read_bytes()
                cls.proof = (here/'VEUX_R44_R2_GPU_WALT_PROOF_40168917960.zip').read_bytes()
                cls.r31 = (here/'VEUX_R31_WALT_RMNET_BINARY_PAIR_MAIN.zip').read_bytes()
                cls.run_meta = {'id':40168917960,'status':'completed','conclusion':'success',
                           'head_sha':g.R44_REPO_SHA, 'head_branch':'main'}
                cls.link=cls.make_link_zip()

            @classmethod
            def make_link_zip(cls, module=None, data=None):
                b=io.BytesIO()
                with zipfile.ZipFile(b,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=1) as z:
                    z.writestr('Module.symvers',cls.symdata if data is None else data)
                    for name,sp in g.R44_MODULES.items():
                        z.writestr(sp['path'],cls.modules[name] if name!=module else b'BAD')
                return b.getvalue()

            def test_r44_genuine_symvers_sha(self):
                self.assertEqual(g.sha(self.symdata),g.R44_SYMVERS_SHA)

            def test_r31_original_zip_sha(self):
                self.assertEqual(g.sha(self.r31),g.R31_ZIP_SHA)

            def test_r44_real_diag_sha(self):
                self.assertEqual(g.sha(self.diag),g.R44_DIAG_ZIP_SHA)

            def test_r44_real_proof_sha(self):
                self.assertEqual(g.sha(self.proof),g.R44_PROOF_ZIP_SHA)

            def test_complete_genuine_material_audit(self):
                report, rows=g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.link,self.diag,self.proof,self.run_meta)
                self.assertEqual(len(rows),140)
                self.assertEqual([m['matched_imports'] for m in report['modules']],[108,32])
                self.assertTrue(report['module_pair_byteidentical_to_r31'])
                for p in ('boot_ready','flash_allowed','runtime_module_load_tested','device_loader_path_proven','complete_vendor_abi_proven'):
                    self.assertFalse(report[p])

            def test_real_elf_arm64_shs(self):
                m=g.parse_elf_module(self.modules['rmnet_shs'],'rmnet_shs')
                self.assertEqual(m['build_id'],'d0fb60306c710f6b')
                self.assertEqual(len(m['versions']),108)
                self.assertEqual(m['undefined_count'],107)

            def test_real_elf_arm64_offload(self):
                m=g.parse_elf_module(self.modules['rmnet_offload'],'rmnet_offload')
                self.assertEqual(m['build_id'],'ee0395e9f972741c')
                self.assertEqual(len(m['versions']),32)
                self.assertEqual(m['undefined_count'],31)

            def test_both_modinfo_exact_5_4(self):
                for name,data in self.modules.items():
                    m=g.parse_elf_module(data,name)
                    self.assertEqual(m['modinfo']['depends'],'')
                    self.assertEqual(m['modinfo']['vermagic'],g.EXPECTED_VERMAGIC)

            def test_real_crc_modules_all_matched(self):
                for name,data in self.modules.items():
                    s, rows=g.compare_module(name,data,self.sym,g.R44_MODULES[name]['sha256'])
                    self.assertEqual(s['symbol_imports'],g.R44_MODULES[name]['expected_imports'])
                    self.assertTrue(all(x['result']=='MATCH' for x in rows))

            def test_crc_mismatch_detected(self):
                sy=copy.deepcopy(self.sym)
                sy['module_layout']['crc'] ^= 1
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_MODULE_CRC_MISMATCH'):
                    g.compare_module('rmnet_shs',self.modules['rmnet_shs'],sy,g.R44_MODULES['rmnet_shs']['sha256'])

            def test_crc_export_missing_detected(self):
                sy=dict(self.sym); sy.pop('memcpy')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_MISSING_EXPORT'):
                    g.compare_module('rmnet_shs',self.modules['rmnet_shs'],sy,g.R44_MODULES['rmnet_shs']['sha256'])

            def test_crc_wrong_binary_hash_detected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_MODULE_BYTES_OR_HASH_DIFFERENT'):
                    g.compare_module('rmnet_shs',self.modules['rmnet_shs'][:-1]+b'X',self.sym,g.R44_MODULES['rmnet_shs']['sha256'])

            def test_crc_wrong_build_report_detected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_BUILD_REPORT_HASH_DIFFERENT'):
                    g.compare_module('rmnet_shs',self.modules['rmnet_shs'],self.sym,'0'*64)

            def test_short_elf_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_MAGIC'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(b'', 'rmnet_shs')

            def test_wrong_elf_endian_rejected(self):
                p=bytearray(self.modules['rmnet_shs']);p[5]=2
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_REQUIRES_ELF64'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(bytes(p),'rmnet_shs')

            def test_wrong_elf_machine_rejected(self):
                p=bytearray(self.modules['rmnet_shs']);struct.pack_into('<H',p,18,62)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_NOT_AARCH64'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(bytes(p),'rmnet_shs')

            def test_wrong_elf_type_rejected(self):
                p=bytearray(self.modules['rmnet_shs']);struct.pack_into('<H',p,16,2)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_NOT_RELOCATABLE'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(bytes(p),'rmnet_shs')

            def test_wrong_module_name_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_MODULE_NAME_DIFFERENT'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(self.modules['rmnet_shs'],'rmnet_offload')

            def test_elf_bad_section_bounds_rejected(self):
                p=bytearray(self.modules['rmnet_shs']);struct.pack_into('<Q',p,40,len(p)+100)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_SECTION_TABLE_BOUNDS'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(bytes(p),'rmnet_shs')

            def test_elf_invalid_sections_rejected(self):
                p=bytearray(self.modules['rmnet_offload']);struct.pack_into('<H',p,58,10)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_SECTION_TABLE_INVALID'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(bytes(p),'rmnet_offload')

            def test_elf_modinfo_vermagic_change_rejected(self):
                p=self.modules['rmnet_offload']
                self.assertIn(b'5.4.274~positron',p)
                b=p.replace(b'5.4.274~positron',b'5.4.273~positron',1)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_VERMAGIC_DIFFERENT'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(b,'rmnet_offload')

            def test_elf_modinfo_depends_change_rejected(self):
                p=self.modules['rmnet_offload']
                self.assertIn(b'depends=\x00',p)
                b=p.replace(b'depends=\x00',b'depends=x',1)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ELF_UNEXPECTED_KO_DEPENDENCIES'):
                    g.parse_elf_module(b,'rmnet_offload')

            def test_bad_symvers_row_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SYMVERS_ROW_INVALID'):
                    g.parse_symvers(self.symdata+b'garbage\n')

            def test_duplicate_symvers_export_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SYMVERS_DUPLICATE_SYMBOL'):
                    g.parse_symvers(self.symdata + self.symdata.splitlines(True)[0])

            def test_missing_symvers_rows_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'SYMVERS_TOO_FEW'):
                    g.parse_symvers(self.symdata.splitlines(True)[0])

            def test_r44_wrong_run_conclusion_rejected(self):
                bad={**self.run_meta,'conclusion':'failure'}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_SOURCE_RUN_NOT_PROVEN'):
                    g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.link,self.diag,self.proof,bad)

            def test_r44_wrong_run_sha_rejected(self):
                bad={**self.run_meta,'head_sha':'0'*40}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_SOURCE_RUN_NOT_PROVEN'):
                    g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.link,self.diag,self.proof,bad)

            def test_r44_wrong_branch_rejected(self):
                bad={**self.run_meta,'head_branch':'experimental'}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_SOURCE_RUN_NOT_PROVEN'):
                    g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.link,self.diag,self.proof,bad)

            def test_archive_bad_module_blob_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R31_VS_R44_BYTE_IDENTITY_NOT_PROVEN'):
                    g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.make_link_zip(module='rmnet_shs'),self.diag,self.proof,self.run_meta)

            def test_archive_wrong_symvers_blob_rejected(self):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'R44_ORIGINAL_SYMVERS_SHA_INVALID'):
                    g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.make_link_zip(data=self.symdata[:-1]+b'X'),self.diag,self.proof,self.run_meta)

            def test_duplicate_archive_entry_rejected(self):
                b=io.BytesIO()
                with zipfile.ZipFile(b,'w') as z:
                    import warnings
                    with warnings.catch_warnings():
                        warnings.simplefilter('ignore',UserWarning)
                        z.writestr('Module.symvers',b'1');z.writestr('Module.symvers',b'2')
                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b.getvalue())) as z:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ZIP_DUPLICATE_MEMBER'):
                        g.zip_validate(z)

            def test_path_traversal_rejected(self):
                b=io.BytesIO()
                with zipfile.ZipFile(b,'w') as z:z.writestr('../evil',b'a')
                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b.getvalue())) as z:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ZIP_UNSAFE_PATH'):
                        g.zip_validate(z)

            def test_symlink_member_rejected(self):
                b=io.BytesIO()
                with zipfile.ZipFile(b,'w') as z:
                    i=zipfile.ZipInfo('symvers');i.create_system=3;i.external_attr=(stat.S_IFLNK|0o777)<<16
                    z.writestr(i,b'destination')
                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b.getvalue())) as z:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ZIP_SYMLINK'):
                        g.zip_validate(z)

            def test_missing_expected_member_rejected(self):
                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(self.link)) as z:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ZIP_SUFFIX_MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS'):
                        g.require_unique_suffix(z,'not-there.ko',2000)

            def test_oversize_zip_member_rejected(self):
                with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(self.link)) as z:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ZIP_MEMBER_TOO_BIG'):
                        g.require_unique_suffix(z,'Module.symvers',2)

            def test_no_implied_device_runtime_pass(self):
                report,_=g.audit_inputs(self.r31,self.link,self.diag,self.proof,self.run_meta)
                for k in ('runtime_module_load_tested','device_loader_path_proven','vendor_rom_init_compatibility_proven','complete_vendor_abi_proven','boot_ready','flash_allowed'):
                    self.assertIs(report[k],False)


        if __name__ == '__main__':unittest.main()

      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -qq -y --no-install-recommends shellcheck; }

        python3 -B - '.github/workflows/VEUX_R47_R44_RMNET_ELF_LOADER_GATE.yml' "$R47_ROOT/out/R47_SHELLCHECK.log" <<'R47_INDEPENDENT_LINT'
        import pathlib,sys,subprocess,hashlib,yaml
        p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); destination=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);raw=p.read_bytes()
        class StrictLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
        def pairs(loader,node):
            r={}
            for k,v in node.value:
                name=loader.construct_object(k,deep=True)
                if name in r:raise ValueError('DUPLICATE_YAML_KEY:'+str(name))
                r[name]=loader.construct_object(v,deep=True)
            return r
        StrictLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,pairs)
        d=yaml.load(raw,Loader=StrictLoader)
        assert d['permissions']=={'contents':'read','actions':'read'}
        assert list(d['on'])==['workflow_dispatch']
        steps=d['jobs']['r47']['steps']; expected=[
         'Checkout exact project repository read-only',
         'Authenticate existing R31 package and create self-contained R47 auditor',
         'Independent actionlint plus ShellCheck and bash -n on every exact run block',
         'Pin official R44 run and fetch original build artifacts with SHA256',
         '36 real ELF/Symvers and negative regression tests',
         'Audit actual R44 modules and exported CRCs, read only',
         'Guard final results and forbid flashing or private R46 reports',
         'Upload text-only R47 results, including failures']
        if [x['name'] for x in steps]!=expected:raise SystemExit('R47_STEP_SCOPE_CHANGED')
        if len([x for x in steps if 'run' in x])!=6:raise SystemExit('R47_RUN_COUNT_CHANGED')
        log=[]
        for index,step in enumerate(steps,1):
            if 'run' not in step:continue
            script=step['run'];script_path=destination.parent/('block_'+str(index).zfill(2)+'.bash')
            script_path.write_text(script)
            for cmd in (['bash','-n',str(script_path)], ['shellcheck','--shell=bash','--severity=warning',str(script_path)]):
                res=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
                if res.returncode:raise SystemExit('R47_LINT_FAILED:'+str(index)+':'+res.stdout+res.stderr)
                log.append(str(index)+':'+cmd[0]+':PASS:'+hashlib.sha256(script.encode()).hexdigest())
            script_path.unlink()
        destination.write_text('\n'.join(log)+'\n')
        print('R47_ACTIONLINT_AND_ALL_EXACT_SHELLCHECK_BASH_BLOCKS=PASS')
        R47_INDEPENDENT_LINT

      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B - "$R47_ROOT/out" <<'R47_FINAL_GUARD'
        import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
        p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);r=json.loads((p/'R47_RESULT.json').read_text())
        req={'R47_STAGE.txt','R47_ACTIONLINT.log','R47_SHELLCHECK.log','R47_TESTS.log',
             'R47_EXECUTION.log','R47_RESULT.json','R47_MODULE_ELF.json','R47_RMNET_140_IMPORTS.csv','R47_BERICHT_DE.txt'}
        actual={f.name for f in p.iterdir() if f.is_file()}
        if actual!=req:raise SystemExit('R47_UNEXPECTED_OUTPUT_FILES:'+str(actual^req))
        if (r.get('schema')!='VEUX_R47_R44_RMNET_BINARY_ELF_PROVENANCE_V1' or
            r.get('result')!='R44_RMNET_140_OF_140_CRC_MATCH_AND_BYTE_IDENTITY' or
            r.get('module_pair_byteidentical_to_r31') is not True or
            [m['matched_imports'] for m in r['modules']] != [108,32] or
            [m['build_id'] for m in r['modules']] != ['d0fb60306c710f6b','ee0395e9f972741c']):
            raise SystemExit('R47_ORIGINAL_BINARY_PROOF_NOT_PASSED')
        for k in ('runtime_module_load_tested','device_loader_path_proven',
                  'vendor_rom_init_compatibility_proven','complete_vendor_abi_proven',
                  'bootloader_dtbo_selection_proven','boot_ready','flash_allowed','source_modified','kernel_built',
                  'historical_2ef0_modules_suitable_for_r44'):
            if r.get(k) is not False:raise SystemExit('R47_UNSAFE_PASS_FLAG:'+k)
        files=list(p.rglob('*'))
        for f in files:
            if f.is_file() and (f.suffix in ('.ko','.img','.dtb','.dtbo','.elf','.bin') or f.name in ('Image','vmlinux')):
                raise SystemExit('R47_BINARY_ARTIFACT_OUTPUT_FORBIDDEN')
        checks=[hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+f.name for f in sorted(files) if f.is_file()]
        (p/'SHA256SUMS.txt').write_text('\n'.join(checks)+'\n')
        print('R47_RESULT_GUARDS=PASS; NO_KERNEL_BUILD; BOOT_READY=NO; FLASH_ALLOWED=NO')
        R47_FINAL_GUARD
        (cd "$R47_ROOT/out" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
        test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
        echo 'R47_REPO_UNCHANGED=YES; NO_MODULE_INSTALLED=YES; PRIVATE_R46_NOT_PUBLISHED=YES'
